ministries.title: Children's Ministry
ministries.description: Kids sing with us and hear a short children's message, then head to Children's Church (through 5th grade) while the sermon goes on.

ministries.title: Wednesday Night Kids & Student Ministry
ministries.description: Kids and students dig into the Bible, make friends, and have fun. Adults have their own Bible study the same night, so the whole family can come.

ministries.title: Wednesday Night Adult Bible Study
ministries.description: Adults open the Bible together in a class taught by Pastor Josh, while kids and students meet in their own groups.

ministries.title: Small Group Bible Studies
ministries.description: A Ladies' Group and a Men's Group meet Monday evenings to study the Bible, pray, and get to know each other.

ministries.title: Men's Ministry
ministries.description: Men get together for prayer and for special nights like Forge Night. Bring a friend.

ministries.title: The Lord's Supper
ministries.description: We take the Lord's Supper together as part of worship on the first Sunday of every month.
